mutations.contract: An unbound edge is the ordinary case: a console line, never the banner.
mutations.note: The banner is the loud surface; a hover that wrote there would flash a warning every time the pointer crossed a row with no binding. Carried over 2026-10-26 when the guard stopped needing a gap row (the live study has none).

mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_kinematic_page_keeps_the_dag_and_says_each_contributor_once (2026-10-26). Every kinematic row posts the bound edge's highlight, so an unbound row tints a face.
